name: dir2site-markdown
description: Makes VS Code's Markdown preview render the way dir2site does: ^^^ figure blocks, {.figure-right} image attributes, and single newlines as line breaks.

dir2siteMarkdown.hardLineBreaks.description: Treat a single newline as a line break, matching how dir2site renders Markdown. Applies to every Markdown preview in the window; takes effect when the preview is next opened.
